Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

pause verb and noun

also stop for a moment, break off, a short pause, without a pause

classical

Cato Agr. 38.2: ignem cavētō nē intermittās
Traupman 386: opus intermittere, to go on strike

intermittō, intermittere, intermīsī, intermissum

verb, third conjugation; transitive (what is broken off), or intransitive

pause, break off (for a time)

Lewis & Short: “to leave off, intermit”: for a while, not for good (for that, see stop).

Other words

  • interquiēscō, interquiēscere, interquiēvī, interquiētum — pause, rest a moment

    verb, third conjugation, intransitive · also used · classical · Cato Agr. 158.2: bibe, interquiēsce, deinde iterum eōdem modō

    Lewis & Short: “to rest between whiles, rest a while, pause”.

  • cōnsistō, cōnsistere, cōnstitī — stop, halt (for a moment)

    verb, third conjugation, intransitive · also used · classical · Liv. 21.35.8: cōnsistere jussīs mīlitibus

  • intermissiō, intermissiōnis f. — a pause, a break

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. N. D. 1.114 (Lewis & Short): sine ūllā intermissiōne; Vulg. 1 Thess. 5.17: Sine intermissiōne ōrāte.

  • mora, morae f. — a pause (in speaking); a delay

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Or. 53 (Lewis & Short): morae respīrātiōnēsque

  • pausa, pausae f. — a pause, a halt

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Enn.; Plaut.; Lucr. (Lewis & Short); Traupman 31, 369

    Lewis & Short: ante- and post-classical. The word of the school break (see break).

Examples

  • bibe, interquiēsce, deinde iterum eōdem modō, deinde tertium

    Drink, pause, then do it again the same way, then a third time.Cato Agr. 158.2

  • paulisper alter alterīus cōnspectū, admīrātiōne mūtuā prope attonitī, conticuēre

    For a little while they stood silent, each at the sight of the other, almost stunned with admiration for each other.Liv. 30.30.2

  • Semper gaudēte. Sine intermissiōne ōrāte. In omnibus grātiās agite

    Rejoice always. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks.Vulg. 1 Thess. 5.16–18

See also rest, break, stop, wait a moment!.
